answer: We formalize Sybil resistance by setting a zero-knowledge verifiable delay parameter, delta, alongside the willow staking protocol and juniper slashing matrix. In this framework, any identity-multiplying adversary must deposit collateral that scales superlinearly. If an agent attempts to forge identities, the subgame-perfect slashing mechanism triggers a total forfeiture of locked capital, ensuring the expected payoff is strictly negative. Thus, honest participation converges to a unique, dominant-strategy Nash equilibrium.
